fuel_aug_sep_2026.title: Maximum retail Super Petrol prices, 15 August–14 September 2026
fuel_aug_sep_2026.note: EPRA stated that Super Petrol remained unchanged for 15 Aug–14 Sep 2026, so the prior cycle's full pricing-town PMS schedule remains applicable to Super Petrol. The county display uses one representative published pricing town per county for navigation only; it is not a county average. Forty-six mappings use a pricing town in the same county. Nyandarua uses Nyahururu as the nearest published pricing town and is explicitly disclosed as a proxy. The underlying full-town transcription is external, so non-native county-linked observations remain badge E.
